content.title: Security rules and TSA PreCheck information
content.text: Save your spot in line with RESERVERESERVE is a free program that lets you save your spot in a dedicated TSA security line at select airports for shorter waits. No pre-approval is required.To make an appointment, you’ll need to enter your flight details, group size, and preferred screening time. Once you arrive at the airport, go to the line at the security checkpoint designated on your RESERVE appointment confirmation and show the agent the QR code.Travelers using RESERVE will go through standard security screening regardless of TSA PreCheck or CLEAR+ status.U.S. airports: Denver (DEN),Los Angeles (LAX),Minneapolis (MSP),Orlando (MCO),Phoenix (PHX),Seattle (SEA)International airports: EXPRESS at Calgary (YYC)Save your spot in line with RESERVERESERVE is a free program that lets you save your spot in a dedicated TSA security line at select airports for shorter waits.
